rules.description: Head injury diagnosis or active problem (timeboxed); source rules 1 and 2 divide this reportable population into alive and deceased subsets, but both subsets report
Traumatic brain injury diagnosis or active problem (timeboxed); source rules 3 and 4 divide this reportable population into alive and deceased subsets, but both subsets report

gaps.valueSet: Patient deceased status and discharge disposition (Not Expired 2.16.840.1.113762.1.4.1146.1107 / Expired 2.16.840.1.113762.1.4.1146.1108)
gaps.reason: SEM_V1 carries neither patient-deceased status nor encounter discharge disposition. Source rules 1–2 and 3–4 are therefore collapsed into their exact condition-level unions because both alive and deceased subsets report; fatal-versus-nonfatal rule attribution is unavailable

The authoritative source states that all trigger codes specific to Head Injury were removed from RCTC in March 2026; an eICR triggered for another condition may still be evaluated for Head Injury using these rules
